Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the informant and learned APP for the State.
2. The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Haspura P.S. Case No. 173 of 2023 registered for the offence under Sections 341, 323, 379, 307, 376, 354, 420/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The petitioner is accused of having committed rape upon the victim.

4. The petitioner is in custody since 28.08.2024.
5.
The informant is a 45 years old lady and she has alleged rape etc. and filed complaint case and learned counsel for the petitioner submits that this is a case of consensual sex.

Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.26438 of 2025(4) dt.06-08-2025 6.
Learned counsel for the informant has vehemently opposed the application of the petitioner for grant of regular bail.
